The '''Highmount Slopes''' was the name given to the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range that formed the eastern edge of the [[Highmount Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The [[Tromper Crags Geothermal Plant]] was built underneath the western side of the Slopes, and the eastern edge of the range was known as the [[Bold Ascent]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Thesh Outpost]] was located underneath the eastern edge of the range, facing the [[Glacial Fissure]] to the east, and the Slopes were home to numerous [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Highmount Slopes appear as a sub-region within the Highmount Ridge on Hoth in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
